metin: Picture the end of a dinner. The plates are cleared, the sofa is right there, and someone suggests a ten minute stroll around the block. It sounds almost too simple to matter. But in a randomized trial of 41 adults with type 2 diabetes, short walks after each meal lowered blood sugar after eating by about 12 percent, compared with one thirty minute walk at any other time of day.
